result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on convergence of prior findings S0-F1 through S0-F3. I re-read the directly touched contract, review-service, route, and test surfaces, checked the package-context proof gap, and reran both required gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: `packageMemberSchema` now requires `artifactVersionId` and no longer exposes the legacy `versionId` member field (`apps/platform/shared/contracts/review-workspace.ts:262-270`). `package-review.service.ts` now reads `member.artifactVersionId` end-to-end (`apps/platform/server/services/review/package-review.service.ts:30-61,118-123`), and updated package-review fixtures/tests use the renamed field (`tests/fixtures/package-snapshots.ts:9-27`, `tests/service/server/package-review-api.test.ts:67-87`).

Legacy `REVIEW_MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE` is removed from the shared review-target error vocabulary (`apps/platform/shared/contracts/review-workspace.ts:130-137`). Direct artifact review now returns `404 ARTIFACT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND` for a missing explicit version (`apps/platform/server/services/review/artifact-review.service.ts:15-24,127-137`; `tests/service/server/artifact-review-api.test.ts:230-257`), direct package review now returns `404 PACKAGE_MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE` for a missing explicit member (`apps/platform/server/routes/review.ts:393-410`; `tests/service/server/package-review-api.test.ts:554-567`), and workspace bootstrap preserves bounded unavailable state with `ARTIFACT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND` (`apps/platform/server/services/review/review-workspace.service.ts:142-160,175-202`; `tests/service/server/review-workspace-api.test.ts:407-434`).

The package-context mutation still implements canonical selection, duplicate cleanup, and idempotent return (`convex/processPackageContexts.ts:110-237`), but the planned proof remains absent: `convex/processPackageContexts.test.ts` still does not exist, and no reviewed test references `upsertCurrentProcessPackageContext`. The test plan still names that file as the authoritative owner for this coverage (`docs/spec-build/v2/epics/05--artifact-model-and-review-provenance-alignment/test-plan.md:160-161,236-240`).

openFindings.title: The new canonical package-context upsert invariant is not backed by the planned automated proof
openFindings.evidence: Story 0 makes one-current-package-context semantics, duplicate cleanup, and idempotent upsert part of the foundation (`docs/spec-build/v2/epics/05--artifact-model-and-review-provenance-alignment/stories/00-foundation.md:115-121,136-138`). The Convex mutation does implement canonical-row selection, duplicate cleanup, and idempotent early return (`convex/processPackageContexts.ts:110-237`), but the authoritative test inventory assigns that proof to `convex/processPackageContexts.test.ts` (`docs/spec-build/v2/epics/05--artifact-model-and-review-provenance-alignment/test-plan.md:160-161,236-240`) and that file is still absent. I also found no reviewed test that exercises `upsertCurrentProcessPackageContext`.

additionalObservations: The follow-up patch added explicit server coverage for the missing-version case; the server suite now passes with 239 tests.
Both requested gates passed again. `guard:no-test-changes` and `test:e2e` remain scaffolded skips in this repo, so they did not add proof for the package-context mutation invariant.
No new regressions were introduced in the touched Story 0 contract or review-route surfaces during this follow-up.
